featured_reviews.name: Jackies Foodplatter
featured_reviews.review_text: Do not waste your money on this Patrawala Cooking Classes. It's just not worth, nothing but a money making racket. The recipes are all wrong with a thousand corrections, unstructured and badly formatted, crap english, which will spoil your dish and your mood. A lot of times, I've missed adding important ingredients because of these reasons. If you miss a few corrections, your dish is gone for a toss. Shaheen Patrawala runs the class now. She is an absolutely arrogant woman and will insult people who say anything against her liking. She is so lazy, that she can't even make the corrections in the computer and then give a clean print out to people enrolling for the class. When I questioned about this, she shamelessly said they are my recipes and she can do as she likes. She has no courtesy and respect to talk to people. They are not even her own recipes. She has inherited from her mother-in-law, who was used to charge a nominal fee. And his woman is now looting people. After making the countless corrections, you won't even feel like following the recipe as the page will look so untidy. Sometimes she forgets to give some corrections and then blames the students that they didn't note it. For the same recipe the corrections keep changing. There is no consistency. She won't accept her fault. She charges a bomb like Rs 1,200 for a 2 to 3 hours course with around 4 to 5 dishes, just not worth. She will just rush through like a Rajdhani Express without even explaining the main points or giving any knowlege about the ingredients. Better to follow YOUTUBE. Her Baking course is PATHETIC!! My cakes got burnt due to her wrong temperatures, my choco lava became hard cup cakes as the bake time was wrong in the recipe. She didn't even provide any knowledge about the Oven settings, which is basic. So you can imagine how pathetic she and her cooking course is.

featured_reviews.name: Shakti Nandan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had Soul Chef cater for our son's first birthday, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. The food was absolutely amazing — every dish was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented. Our guests couldn’t stop raving about it!

The service was equally impressive. The team was professional, attentive, and Mr. Lancy made sure everything ran smoothly without us having to worry about a thing. From start to finish, they were a pleasure to work with.

Highly recommend Soul Chef for anyone looking for great food and exceptional service. We’ll definitely be reaching out to them again for future events!

featured_reviews.name: Surbhi Shukla
featured_reviews.review_text: I was in conversation with Sam & Anish, two of the most tactless men working in hospitality. They were extremely condescending when I asked if a tasting was possible. They messed up my order on the day of my birthday party, and were extremely rude, argumentative and took advantage of the fact that I couldn't pull up text messages to prove my order because I had to entertain and make immediate arrangements to feed guests. The food was strictly ok, presentation and aesthetic is extremely poor. The servers however are lovely, prompt, competent, well-spoken and very well mannered.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Agrawal
Gaurav Angolkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve worked with Anish from Soul Chef across multiple events, and every single client has been happy with the food and service. Consistent quality and a great team to work with.

featured_reviews.name: aritri kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: The catering was very good for my house party. All my guests absolutely loved it. All the guys who came from soul chef were so nice and gentle. The food was fantastic. Each and every dish was served beautifully and tasted even better. So so happy that I found you guys and I will recommend you all to as many people as I can. Soul chef is going to be a regular at my house now!

featured_reviews.name: Dream Artist
featured_reviews.review_text:
From being a Chartered Accountant to becoming a Chef, Anish Pevekar’s journey is nothing short of inspiring. What seemed like a tough switch, he made it look effortless — and his food says it all! Every dish he prepares at Soul Chef is so delicious, you just can’t stop licking your fingers. The consistency in taste is outstanding — every time I eat, I wonder how he keeps the flavors so perfect!

My name is Kantivardhan Choraria, founder of Dreamartist — where you Dream and we Create. For every event I organize, Anish is the one who takes complete charge of the food. Be it a gathering of 5 or a celebration of 500, Soul Chef is my go-to recommendation. Trust me, your guests will keep talking about the food long after the event is over!

featured_reviews.name: Anuradha Hunnur
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience with soul chef team has been amazing to say the least. Right from helping me out with a very last minute request for catering a house party of 20 pax to customisations needed to accommodate for kids needs - they have been truly a delight to work with. The chef - helper - server team sent on site are quite professionals as well. Food is delicious and their spread is wide. They ensure minimal mess post the party and help reset kitchen as much possible to original state. Have availed their services thrice in a month already and look forward to more!

featured_reviews.name: vignesh (Go_vigy)
featured_reviews.review_text: Soul Chef Catering Services is a top-notch choice for any event, big or small, from corporate gatherings to cozy house parties, and they particularly shine with their yacht party catering. I’ve personally enjoyed their food, and it’s not only delicious but also exceptionally hygienic, reflecting their commitment to quality and freshness. The team is professional, friendly, and goes above and beyond to ensure every detail is perfect, leaving a memorable impression on guests. If you’re looking for versatile and reliable catering, Soul Chef is highly recommended.
